lines.en: label christmasfive6:
if tsukasaspring3 == True and christmastsubasa1 == True:
scene christmasfivesix1
Tsukasa Tsukioka didn’t need to be alone. There were people here who were paid to prevent that sort of thing.
lines.zh: Tsukasa Tsukioka 本不必独处。这宅子里有些人就是拿钱来防止这种事的。

lines.en: She’d given them the holiday off, though.
lines.zh: 不过她给他们放了假。

lines.en: It was an uncommon gesture for her, but she had hoped that there’d be someone else to spend time with today.
lines.zh: 这对她来说是个不寻常的举动,可她原本盼着今天能有别人陪她一起过。

lines.en: She had hoped that someone else would have been willing to speak to her or ask her about her interests. She had hoped that someone else would have looked at her or cared for her.
lines.zh: 她原本盼着会有别人愿意跟她说话,或者问问她的兴趣。她原本盼着会有别人看看她、在乎她。

lines.en: But then someone {i}did.{/i} And it felt strange.
lines.zh: 可后来,{i}真的{/i}有人这么做了。而这感觉很奇怪。

lines.en: She felt dumb for leaving after getting what she wanted. But if she stayed in that room any longer, she felt as if her heart would have beaten its way out of her chest.
lines.zh: 得到自己想要的之后就离开,她觉得自己很蠢。可要是她再在那间屋子里待下去,她觉得自己的心脏会一路跳到胸腔外面来。

lines.en: “What {i}was{/i} that strange feeling?” she thought. “Is it always like this when someone puts you first?”
lines.zh: 「那种奇怪的感觉是什么?」她想。「当有人把你放在第一位的时候,都是这样的吗?」

lines.en: Her eyes remained focused on the floor — so clean that she could see her face reflecting off of it. But it looked different from the way it normally did.
lines.zh: 她的眼睛始终盯着地板——干净得能照出她的脸。可那张脸看起来和平时不太一样。

lines.en: She looked older. More mature. Or perhaps that’s just how she {i}wanted{/i} to look as she had never felt like {i}more{/i} of a child than she did right now.
lines.zh: 她看起来更年长。更成熟。又或者,那只是她{i}希望{/i}自己看起来的样子,因为她从未像此刻这样,觉得自己是个小孩。

lines.en: She clutched a book tightly to her chest, attempting to suppress and cage the rhythm of her heart as it bored into her. And it worked for the most part. The sounds of her footsteps masked the beating.
lines.zh: 她把一本书紧紧抱在胸前,试图压制、囚禁那正往她身体里钻的心跳节奏。而这大体上起了作用。脚步声盖过了心跳。

lines.en: She wished that Jeeves were here.
lines.zh: 她希望 Jeeves 在身边。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix2
But then she wished that she hadn’t wished that because wishing it felt weirder than wishes should.
lines.zh: 可随即她又希望自己没许这个愿,因为许下这个愿的感觉,比愿望本身该有的感觉更奇怪。

lines.en: The book began to vibrate. Ancient magics, perhaps?
lines.zh: 那本书开始震动。也许是远古的魔法?

lines.en: Or was it just the seed of self-doubt, sprouting up from the pit in her stomach? Growing, growing, growing into a beautiful flower she’d package up and give to the man who planted it there in the first place.
lines.zh: 又或者,那只是自我怀疑的种子,从她胃里那个坑里发了芽?长啊,长啊,长成了一朵美丽的花,而她会把它包装好,送给那个最先把种子种在那儿的人。

lines.en: : I’m merely...impressed! That is all.
lines.zh: : 我只是……有点佩服!仅此而已。

lines.en: : To think a lowly peasant would...put his pride on the line for...
lines.zh: : 真没想到,一个低贱的平民会……为了……把自尊都押上去……

lines.en: : Maybe it...wouldn’t be a...{i}terrible{/i} idea to-
lines.zh: : 也许……那也……不算是个{i}糟糕{/i}的主意——

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix3
: Tch. He {i}did{/i} get some on my shoe.
lines.zh: : 啧。他还{i}真{/i}弄了点到我鞋子上。

lines.en: : I’ll have to give him a piece of my mind the next time we-
lines.zh: : 下次我们再——的时候,我得好好说说他。

lines.en: : Mother?
lines.zh: : 母亲?

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix4
: Tsu...Tsukasa! I...you...where are your guards? You shouldn’t be out here alone.
lines.zh: : Tsu……Tsukasa!我……你……你的护卫呢?你不该一个人出来。

lines.en: : Are you back from your trip already? Can I ask you some questions about...things?
lines.zh: : 你们旅行已经回来了吗?我能问你一些关于……某些事的问题吗?

lines.en: : Tsukasa, I am very busy right now. Your father and I...decided to put an early end to the ski trip to attend to some matters at home.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,我现在很忙。你父亲和我……决定提前结束滑雪之旅,回来处理家里的一些事。

lines.en: : Is it because you’re adults and adults need private time together?
lines.zh: : 是因为你们是成年人,而成年人需要独处的时间吗?

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix5
: Hmph...pfft! Private time? With your {i}father?{/i} What year is this? 1995?
lines.zh: : 哼……噗!独处的时间?跟你{i}父亲{/i}?现在是哪年?1995 年吗?

lines.en: : Um...I don’t know what that...means...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不知道那……是什么意思……

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix6
: I didn’t imagine you would. But the fact remains that you {i}know{/i} you’re supposed to be in the care of your sister and {i}Sensei{/i} right now. Yet you’re out here alone.
lines.zh: : 我猜你也不会知道。但事实是,你明明{i}清楚{/i}这会儿你该由你姐姐和 {i}Sensei{/i} 照看。可你一个人跑出来了。

lines.en: : And unfortunately, I don’t have the time to ask “why” as I just had to take care of a...{i}rodent.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而不巧的是,我没时间问「为什么」,因为我刚刚才处理掉一只……{i}啮齿动物。{/i}

lines.en: : In the manor?
lines.zh: : 在宅子里?

lines.en: : Yes, Tsukasa. In the manor.
lines.zh: : 是的,Tsukasa。在宅子里。

lines.en: : Is that a lie too? Like the ski trip?
lines.zh: : 那也是谎话吗?就像滑雪之旅一样?

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix7
: I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么?

lines.en: : If you don’t want me around...just tell me. I’m not a little girl anymore. You don’t have to lie.
lines.zh: : 如果你不想让我在身边……直接告诉我就好。我已经不是小女孩了。你不用撒谎。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...you {i}are{/i} a little girl. And you haven’t the faintest idea of what you’re talking about right now.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……你{i}就是{/i}个小女孩。而且你对自己现在在说些什么一无所知。

lines.en: : So you {i}didn’t{/i} ask Onee-sama and Jeeves to spend time with me so you could...keep me away from something? Because that’s what it looks like.
lines.zh: : 所以你{i}没有{/i}让 Onee-sama 和 Jeeves 来陪我,好让你……把我从某件事旁边支开?因为看起来就是这样。

lines.en: : What...gave you that idea?
lines.zh: : 是什么……让你这么想的?

lines.en: : My bloodline.
lines.zh: : 我的血统。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix8
: You and Onee-sama are the smartest women in the whole wide world...but one day, I’ll be up there too. And when that day comes-
lines.zh: : 你和 Onee-sama 是全世界最聪明的女人……但总有一天,我也会站到那个位置上。而等那一天到来——

lines.en: : Tsukasa. We make eye contact when we’re speaking to one another. You know the rules.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa。我们说话的时候要看着对方的眼睛。规矩你是知道的。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix9
: Why don’t you want me?...
lines.zh: : 为什么你不想要我?……

lines.en: : I can {i}still{/i} be useful...I don’t need to be the heir. I don’t need to-
lines.zh: : 我{i}还是{/i}可以有用的……我又不必当继承人。我不需要——

lines.en: : You don’t need to tell me how {i}useful{/i} you can be, Tsukasa. That is something I know...{i}all{/i} too well.
lines.zh: : 你用不着告诉我你有多「{i}有用{/i}」,Tsukasa。这一点我……{i}再清楚不过了{/i}。

lines.en: : But to accuse me of not wanting you?...
lines.zh: : 可你竟指控我不想要你?……

lines.en: : That shows me you’re nowhere {i}near{/i} as smart as you think you are.
lines.zh: : 这说明你还{i}远没有{/i}你自己以为的那么聪明。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix10
: Go to your room. And don’t come out until tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: : 回你房间去。明天早上之前不许出来。

lines.en: : If you need anything, summon one of your men. Or {i}Jeeves{/i} if you prefer.
lines.zh: : 需要什么就唤你的手下。或者你更喜欢的话,唤 {i}Jeeves{/i}。

lines.en: : But Jeeves...I don’t want to bother him! He’s already been the {i}only{/i} person who’s been nice to me today and I don’t want to ruin {i}his{/i} Christmas too! Like I’m ruining yours now!
lines.zh: : 可 Jeeves……我不想打扰他!他已经是今天{i}唯一{/i}一个对我好的人了,我不想连{i}他的{/i}圣诞节也毁掉!就像我现在正在毁掉你的一样!

lines.en: : With an attitude like that, you’ll never last in this family.
lines.zh: : 就凭这种态度,你在这个家里撑不了多久。

lines.en: : But Mom!
lines.zh: : 可是妈妈!

lines.en: : Go...to your room.
lines.zh: : 回……你房间去。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix11
scene christmasfivesix12
scene christmasfivesix13
: I need a drink.
lines.zh: : 我需要喝一杯。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix14
: Mmmmmmmngh!!!!!
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯!!!!!

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix15
: No! I won’t cry! Tsukiokas never cry!
lines.zh: : 不!我不哭!Tsukioka 家的人从来不哭!

lines.en: : I’ll show her! Onee-sama too! I’ll show them I belong here! They’ll see!
lines.zh: : 我要让她看看!也让 Onee-sama 看看!我要让她们知道我属于这里!她们会看到的!

lines.en: scene black
: Tsukasa Tsukioka...is going to clean her own room!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa Tsukioka……要自己打扫自己的房间!

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix16
: AAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHH! You were SO COOL out there, Niki! It’s no wonder everyone loves you!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!Niki,你在台上太帅了!难怪大家都喜欢你!

lines.en: : Like, if someone strapped me to a chair and bound all of my limbs and forced me to listen to nothing but Tokimeki Labyrinth for the rest of my life, I’d just die happy! No problem at all!
lines.zh: : 就是说啊,要是有人把我绑在椅子上,捆住四肢,逼我这辈子只能听 Tokimeki Labyrinth,我也会幸福地死掉!一点问题都没有!

lines.en: : All in a day’s work, Ami. Being cool and lovable is practically second nature to me by now.
lines.zh: : 小菜一碟,Ami。又酷又惹人爱,到如今几乎已经是我的第二天性了。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix17

: And that part where the lights cut out and everything got all quiet, then BOOM! You were right there under a spotlight in a new costume! Like, how did you even get dressed that quickly?! It was like five seconds!
lines.zh: : 还有那段,灯全灭了,一切都安静下来,然后轰!你就穿着新演出服出现在聚光灯下了!话说你到底是怎么换得那么快的?!就好像只用了五秒钟!

lines.en: : Cute girl magic, obviously.
lines.zh: : 当然是可爱女孩的魔法。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix18
: Really?! But I only know how to do that with my hair!
lines.zh: : 真的?!可我只会对我的头发用这招!

lines.en: : You’ll gain the ability to control your outfits later on in life if you keep working hard enough. And, you know what? As a Christmas gift, I’ve got the perfect opportunity for you to do that.
lines.zh: : 只要你一直这么努力,以后你也会掌握控制服装的本事。而且你知道吗?作为圣诞礼物,我这儿正好有个完美的机会让你试试。

lines.en: : I’ll do anything! Just name it, and it will be done! Even if you want to kiss me!
lines.zh: : 我什么都愿意做!你说什么我就做什么!就算你想亲我也行!

lines.en: : I swear to fucking God that if you try to kiss me in this locker room that I’m just never inviting another girl to one of my shows again.
lines.zh: : 我对天发誓,你要是敢在这间更衣室里亲我,我就再也不请任何女孩来看我的演出了。

lines.en: : I’m just saying if you {i}wanted{/i} to, I’d totally do it right now!
lines.zh: : 我只是说,如果你{i}想{/i}的话,我现在就完全愿意!

lines.en: : Better idea — instead of that, why not join me on-stage for the encore? It’s Shining Star, so I {i}know{/i} you know the words.
lines.zh: : 有个更好的主意——与其那样,不如上台跟我一起返场?是 Shining Star,所以我{i}知道{/i}你会歌词。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix19
: Wait...me?! Up there?! Next to you?! Are you kidding? Nobody wants to see that! I’m nowhere near as cute and cool as you!
lines.zh: : 等等……我?!上台?!站在你旁边?!你开玩笑吧?没人想看那个!我可远远没有你那么可爱、那么酷!

lines.en: : And I’m, like...a {i}bad{/i} dancer, Niki. I haven’t done it around you because I don’t want you to hate me. But like, it’s bad. {i}Really{/i} bad.
lines.zh: : 而且我,那个……跳舞很{i}差{/i},Niki。我从没在你面前跳过,因为我不想让你讨厌我。可真的,很差。{i}差得要命{/i}。

lines.en: : Who cares? There are tons of people out there who fawn over girls like that. You might even gain a few fans while you’re at it and then not have to only shoot for marrying your dad anymore.
lines.zh: : 谁在乎?外面有一大堆人就吃这一套。说不定你还能顺带圈几个粉,这样你就不必只把「嫁给爸爸」当人生目标了。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix20
: That’s not true. You have like a gazillion fans and {i}you{/i} had sex with him like a hundred times yesterday.
lines.zh: : 才不是呢。你有大概是无数个粉丝,而且{i}你{/i}昨天跟他上床上了大概一百次。

lines.en: : Yes, but {i}I{/i} am not related to him.
lines.zh: : 是啊,可{i}我{/i}又不是他的亲人。

lines.en: : That part just makes it better.
lines.zh: : 这一点只会让它更棒。

lines.en: : I am going to immediately forget you said that.
lines.zh: : 我要立刻把你说的话忘掉。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix21
: Hey, you haven’t seen my eye shadow lying around, have you? I need to fix myself up before going back out there.
lines.zh: : 嘿,你有没有看到我的眼影落在哪儿?我得在回去之前补一下妆。

lines.en: : You do your own makeup too? You’re seriously, like...the perfect idol! No wonder Dad has so much sex with you!
lines.zh: : 你也自己化妆?你真的,那个……就是完美的偶像!难怪爸爸跟你上那么多次床!

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix22
: A simple “no” would have sufficed.
lines.zh: : 一句简单的「没有」就够了。

lines.en: : I’ll keep an eye out, Niki! If I can take them off of you, of course! Can you show me how to do my makeup like yours after the show? And is it even okay for us to be talking when there’s still an encore to-
lines.zh: : 我会帮你留意的,Niki!当然,前提是我能把眼睛从你身上挪开!演出结束之后,你能教我化你那样的妆吗?还有,返场还没开始,我们这么聊天真的没关系吗——

lines.en: : They’ll wait out there as long as I want them to. There’s no rush.
lines.zh: : 他们愿意在外面等多久就等多久。不急。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix23
: And I will gladly show you how I do my makeup after the show. On {i}one{/i} condition.
lines.zh: : 演出结束后,我很乐意教你化妆。有{i}一个{/i}条件。

lines.en: : Anything you want!
lines.zh: : 什么条件都行!

lines.en: : Stop talking about sex with your dad.
lines.zh: : 别再聊跟你爸爸上床的事。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix24
: Breakfast in bed?! Got it! Anything for you, my queen!
lines.zh: : 床上早餐?!明白!为了你我什么都做,我的女王!

lines.en: : Ami, I know you did not just hear “breakfast in bed” out of that.
lines.zh: : Ami,我知道你不可能从那句话里听出「床上早餐」。

lines.en: : Me too! I just figured I’d offer a reasonable alternative instead and those things seem pretty closely related in value, don’t they?
lines.zh: : 我也觉得!我只是想着干脆提个合理的替代方案,而且这两样东西在价值上似乎相当接近,不是吗?

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you’re overvaluing breakfast or undervaluing your father.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你是在高估早餐,还是在低估你父亲。

lines.en: : Breakfast is the most important meal of the day!
lines.zh: : 早餐是一天中最重要的一餐!

lines.en: : Well, that answers that question.
lines.zh: : 好吧,这就回答了那个问题。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix25
: So we’re good, then?! One colossal platter of Ami’s breakfast in bed in exchange for makeup lessons?!
lines.zh: : 那我们说定了?!用 Ami 的一大盘床上早餐换化妆课?!

lines.en: : No! You heard me!
lines.zh: : 不!你听清我说的话!

lines.en: : {i}Two{/i} colossal platters of Ami’s breakfast in bed?
lines.zh: : {i}两{/i}大盘 Ami 的床上早餐?

lines.en: : A million times, no! Just tell me what I need to do to get you stop thirsting for my boyfriend and you can have whatever you want from me!
lines.zh: : 一百万次,不!你就告诉我,我该怎么做才能让你别再对我的男朋友发春,你要什么我都给你!

lines.en: : Fine. {i}Three{/i} colossal platters of Ami’s breakfast in bed. But that’s my final offer. I go all-out for breakfast. Just like {i}you{/i} go all out when you’re fucking my dad!
lines.zh: : 好吧。{i}三{/i}大盘 Ami 的床上早餐。但这是我的最后报价。我做早餐是全力以赴的。就像{i}你{/i}操我爸爸时也是全力以赴一样!

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix26
: Ami! It’s no business of yours how hard I fuck your dad! Do you understand?!
lines.zh: : Ami!我操你爸爸有多卖力,跟你没关系!你明白吗?!

lines.en: : {i}Hi.{/i} I’m Ami. Nice to meet you, Niki’s manager lady.
lines.zh: : {i}嗨。{/i}我是 Ami。很高兴认识你,Niki 的经纪人女士。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix27
: What the fuck do you want, Patrice?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈想干什么,Patrice?!

lines.en: : You don’t need to {i}yell{/i} at me, Niki. I just need to know when you’re planning on going back out-
lines.zh: : 你不用冲我{i}吼{/i},Niki。我只是想知道你打算什么时候回去——

lines.en: : Damn it, Patrice! I’ll go out there whenever the fuck I want!
lines.zh: : 该死,Patrice!我想什么时候出去就什么时候出去!

lines.en: : I sure hope you don’t talk to Ami’s dad that way when you’re fucking him.
lines.zh: : 我真希望你操 Ami 爸爸的时候,别用这种口气跟他说话。

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix28
: Fuck you, Patrice! There goes your Christmas bonus, you whoooooore!
lines.zh: : 去你的,Patrice!你的圣诞节奖金没了,你这个婊———子!

lines.en: : I like her. She’s not as intimidated by you as I thought she’d be.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢她。她可没有我以为的那么怕你。

lines.en: : I’ve fired her like fifty times and she just won’t go away!
lines.zh: : 我已经炒了她大概五十次了,可她就是不走!

lines.en: scene christmasfivesix29
: Kind of like how I’ve asked {i}you{/i} to stop getting all weird about this stuff fifty-{i}thousand{/i} times and you’re somehow getting {i}worse!{/i}
lines.zh: : 就像我让{i}你{/i}别再对这种事犯怪,已经求了你五{i}万{/i}次,可你不知怎么反而{i}更严重了!{/i}

lines.en: : Have you considered that maybe {i}you’re{/i} the one who’s getting worse and that this is just a lovable character trait of mine?
lines.zh: : 你有没有想过,也许变本加厉的那个人是{i}你{/i},而这只是我一个讨人喜欢的性格特点?

lines.en: : Incest is not a lovable character trait!
lines.zh: : 乱伦可不是什么讨人喜欢的性格特点!

lines.en: : So if Sensei asked you if you wanted to have a threesome with him and Noriko, you’d say no?
lines.zh: : 那么,如果 Sensei 问你想不想和他还有 Noriko 来一场三人行,你会说不?

lines.en: : Yes! How is that even a question?!
